reserveDecision: Use 0.05 TON per NFT for testnet as a conservative safety candidate. Do not reduce it to the Sandbox minimum until real testnet measurements are complete.
testnetChecksRequired: verify standard royalty getter and message response
verify attacker cannot change metadata root
verify owner reveal switches metadata root without replacing NFT
record actual fees and reserve margin
secretHandling: Never commit or paste a mnemonic, seed phrase or private key. Deployment signing credentials must stay outside the repository.
